The XXTEA primitive is implemented in codec.py (key '...|...' and non-standard delta 0x9E5729B1, recovered from the DEX) and reused by file_decoder.py; nothing under android/ changes. AM Tunnel Lite stays online-only, no offline port.

files.note: pdrv2.json is the app's own local copy of the catalog (same outer format as the remote body); the .pdtv2 suffix is registered in file-formats.json / engine.py _C8_FILE_ENGINES. The 1,000 embedded wg am*.conf assets parse (Endpoint/Hash1/Hash2) via file_decoder.py --wg for direct/CLI use only — they are APK-internal assets, not a user import format, so no suffix is registered for them. There is NO user file import and NO text scheme: the manifest declares no import intent-filter, no picker and no custom scheme (udp://* are DNS options, not import links).
